relevance_note: Supplementary Table S1 lists 34 HA20 patients by label with their TNFAIP3 variants ("Table S1: Characteristics of patients with HA20."), and the text gives individual details for HA20-1, HA20-14 and HA20-15.
method_note: Individuals and variants were transcribed from supplementary Table S1 (PDF text; columns Patient, Family, Family Member, TNFAIP3 nucleotide exchange, A20 amino acid exchange) by a short Python script in the scratch directory; I checked all 34 rows against the table by eye. Out of scope (no rows): the ABC DLBCL and MF/SS lymphoma patients with somatic TNFAIP3 mutations (Table S2), the A20-deficient DLBCL single-cell case, healthy donors, and mice. HA20-14: the second TNFAIP3 hit c.1880_1881delGT (p.Cys627fs) and MYD88 c.617C > G (p.Ser206Cys) were found only in lymphoma tissue (somatic), so no variant rows. Family relations in Table S1 ('Daughter', 'Son', 'Father', 'Paternal Grandmother', etc.) were read as relative to the family's Index Case; inheritance was recorded only where a parent in the same family carries the same variant (index case as parent of daughter/son rows: 'inherited unspecified parent' because the index case's sex is not given; Family-3 index case: father carries it, 'inherited paternal'; Family-3 father: his mother, the paternal grandmother, carries it, 'inherited maternal'). The Family-2 granddaughter (HA20-22) and Family-4 brother (HA20-27) have no stated carrier parent: inheritance not reported. Zygosity left 'not reported' for all: the paper speaks of 'heterozygous TNFAIP3 loss' in the cohort only in general terms and never states zygosity per patient or for a named group in a variant statement. Variant type left 'not reported' except HA20-15 ('chromosomal deletion'); no class was derived from HGVS strings. Protein cells 'intron 2'/'intron 5' (HA20-2, HA20-23 to HA20-25) are not p. descriptions, so protein_hgvs is null; HA20-15's 'deletion in 6q23.3' is recorded as the original string with cDNA/protein null. Singletons HA20-1 to HA20-15 (Family 'none') are not called index cases: is_proband null, family label not reported. No checklist item is addressed for any individual (HA20-1's cytokine elevations are not CRP/ESR; lymphoma in HA20-14/HA20-15 was not mapped to 'lymphoproliferation or lymphadenopathy'). The statement that two of 34 patients developed lymphoma was not used to exclude lymphoma in others because the paper says no standardized monitoring was performed. No stacked (' / ') cells in this paper. Contradictions: the Results and Methods say scRNA-seq was done on PBMCs from HA20-1 and HA20-21, but the Fig. 6C legend names HA20-1 and HA20-34. HA20-26 to HA20-28: 'c.271A>T' (a substitution) is printed with 'p.Lys91fs*' (a frameshift); recorded as printed. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the Methods mention 'already published TNFAIP3 mutations from HA20 families' (Infevers) but do not state that these patients were described in an earlier publication.
